preparations.title: Breakfast Preserves
preparations.description: P01–P03 · Seville marmalade, strawberry and vanilla confiture, and raspberry confiture. Opening breakfast preserves; the marmalade comes from the January reserve.

preparations.title: Summer Fruit Preserves
preparations.description: P04–P06 · Apricot and vanilla, bourbon and black cherry, and blackcurrant preserves. Hatfield Original is credited on the cherry label.

preparations.title: Curd & Compote
preparations.description: P07–P08 · Lemon and verbena curd and peach and vanilla compote. Fresh chilled preparations for breakfast and pastry, labelled Keep Refrigerated.

preparations.title: Table Condiments
preparations.description: P09–P10 · Moutarde de la maison and tomato ketchup with red-wine vinegar. A mustard jar and practical sauce bottle for everyday table service.

preparations.title: Cornichons, Shallots & Red Onions
preparations.description: P11, P12, P15 · Cornichons with tarragon, shallots in herb vinegar and quick-pickled red onions. The onion preparation remains chilled.

preparations.title: Savoury Pantry
preparations.description: P13–P14, P16–P17 · Onion confit, tomato and Espelette confit, beetroot with orange and coriander, and courgette with mustard seed. Stored according to each preparation; the beetroot is chilled.

preparations.title: Granola, Crackers & Savoury Sablés
preparations.description: P18–P20 · Oat, almond and seed granola, seeded rye crackers, and Parmesan and black-pepper sablés. Dry storage jars sized for their contents.

preparations.title: Biscuits & Bar Snacks
preparations.description: P21–P24 · Butter shortbread, dark-chocolate and sea-salt sablés, rosemary and smoked-salt almonds, and lime-leaf and chilli cashews. Regular baking and bar-snack batches.

preparations.title: Cocktail Cherries, Syrup & Cordials
preparations.description: P25–P28 · Cocktail cherries, vanilla syrup, ginger and lemongrass cordial, and passion-fruit and lime cordial. House bar preparations; both cordials are kept refrigerated. The cordials are specified by Crispin Vale and made by Rafael’s kitchen to his specifications.

preparations.title: House Ice Creams
preparations.description: P29, P30, P38 · Vanilla-bean, dark-chocolate, and cherry and bourbon swirl ice creams in labelled freezer tubs. Hatfield Original is credited on the cherry and bourbon label. Shown open for the photograph; stored covered and frozen.

preparations.title: House Sauces
preparations.description: P34–P37 · Albury brown sauce, Espelette chilli sauce, salted caramel sauce and chocolate fudge sauce. The two savoury sauces are in practical sauce bottles like the ketchup; the two sweet sauces are in jars. All carry the charcoal and muted-gold pantry label with the architectural house mark and Rafael Bellocq's name.

preparations.title: Elderflower & Lemon Cordial
preparations.description: P31 · Core cordial; kept chilled. The cordials are specified by Crispin Vale and made by Rafael’s kitchen to his specifications.

preparations.title: Raspberry & Lemon Verbena Cordial
preparations.description: P32 · Core cordial; kept chilled. The cordials are specified by Crispin Vale and made by Rafael’s kitchen to his specifications.

preparations.title: Blackcurrant & Bay Cordial
preparations.description: P33 · Core cordial; kept chilled. The cordials are specified by Crispin Vale and made by Rafael’s kitchen to his specifications.

preparations.title: Rhubarb & Orange Cordial
preparations.description: Spring seasonal cordial; recipe and packaging reference. The cordials are specified by Crispin Vale and made by Rafael’s kitchen to his specifications.

preparations.title: Blackberry & Apple Cordial
preparations.description: Autumn seasonal cordial; recipe and packaging reference. The cordials are specified by Crispin Vale and made by Rafael’s kitchen to his specifications.

preparations.title: New House Cordials & Syrup
preparations.description: P39–P42 · White peach and thyme, pink grapefruit and rosemary, and pear and green cardamom cordials, plus demerara syrup. Short clear Albury drinks bottles with gold caps and ivory/bottle-green front labels; Crispin specifies the drinks and Rafael’s kitchen makes them.

preparations.title: Sorrento lemon cordial
preparations.description: P43 · Sorrento lemon juice and peel, with a clean, bright finish. Core citrus cordial, specified by Crispin and made by Rafael’s kitchen. Kept chilled; current batch confirmed for service.

preparations.title: Blood orange cordial
preparations.description: P44 · Distinctive blood-orange fruit with a restrained bitter-peel finish. Core citrus cordial, specified by Crispin and made by Rafael’s kitchen. Kept chilled; current batch confirmed for service.

preparations.title: Lime cordial
preparations.description: P45 · A straightforward lime cordial with fresh zest and a crisp finish. Core citrus cordial, specified by Crispin and made by Rafael’s kitchen. Kept chilled; current batch confirmed for service.

preparations.title: Sweet orange cordial
preparations.description: P46 · Familiar sweet-orange fruit, balanced with gentle peel bitterness. Core citrus cordial, specified by Crispin and made by Rafael’s kitchen. Kept chilled; current batch confirmed for service.
